empirical.zh: 實證的、以經驗為根據的

ex.en: There is little empirical evidence for this theory.
ex.zh: 這個理論幾乎沒有實證證據。

ex.en: The study is based on empirical data.
ex.zh: 這項研究是根據實證資料。

empirical.en: based on what is seen or tested, not only on ideas

ex.en: Saving energy can reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 節約能源可以減少溫室氣體排放到大氣中。

ex.en: As a result of some factories using fossil fuels, chemical emissions have already caused serious environmental problems.
ex.zh: 由於一些工廠使用化石燃料，化學物質的排放已經造成嚴重的環境問題。

emission.en: a gas or other substance that is sent out into the air

ex.en: You can embed the video in your website.
ex.zh: 你可以把影片嵌入你的網站。

ex.en: The chip is embedded in the card.
ex.zh: 晶片嵌在卡片裡。

embed.en: to fix something firmly inside something else

ex.en: These values are deeply embedded in our culture.
ex.zh: 這些價值觀深植於我們的文化中。

ex.en: That memory is embedded in my mind.
ex.zh: 那段記憶深深烙印在我心裡。

embed.en: to make an idea or feeling a strong and lasting part of something

ex.en: The 1960s saw the emergence of the Civil Rights movement in the United States.
ex.zh: 1960 年代，美國興起了民權運動。

ex.en: The emergence of AI has changed many industries.
ex.zh: 人工智慧的興起改變了許多產業。

ex.en: We are seeing the emergence of new competitors in Asia.
ex.zh: 我們看到亞洲出現了新的競爭對手。

emergence.en: the start of something new or its first appearance

ex.en: Managers should empower employees to make decisions.
ex.zh: 主管應該授權員工做決定。

ex.en: The training empowers staff to solve problems themselves.
ex.zh: 這項訓練讓員工有能力自己解決問題。

empower.en: to give someone the power or confidence to do something

ex.en: She embodies the spirit of the company.
ex.zh: 她體現了公司的精神。

ex.en: The new design embodies simplicity and elegance.
ex.zh: 新設計展現了簡約與優雅。

embody.en: to be a clear example of an idea or quality

ex.en: The program focuses on the empowerment of women.
ex.zh: 這個計畫著重於女性賦權。

ex.en: Employee empowerment can improve job satisfaction.
ex.zh: 授權給員工可以提升工作滿意度。

empowerment.en: the process of giving people more power and control over their lives

ex.en: I never answer email messages from people I don't know.
ex.zh: 我從不回覆陌生人寄來的電子郵件。

ex.en: Can you please copy me on that email?
ex.zh: 那封信可以副本給我嗎？

ex.en: I will send it by email this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我今天下午會用電子郵件寄出。

email.en: a message sent from one computer to another over the Internet

ex.en: I'll email you the report this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我今天下午會把報告用電子郵件寄給你。

ex.en: Please email me if you have any questions.
ex.zh: 如果有任何問題，請寄信給我。

email.en: to send someone a message over the Internet

ex.en: A chicken hatches an egg and a chick emerges.
ex.zh: 母雞孵蛋，小雞破殼而出。

ex.en: In the 1960s, the civil rights movement emerged in the United States.
ex.zh: 1960 年代，美國興起了民權運動。

ex.en: New problems emerged during the test.
ex.zh: 測試期間出現了新問題。

emerge.en: to come out from a hidden or closed place

ex.en: China is an emerging market.
ex.zh: 中國是新興市場。

ex.en: We are investing in emerging technologies.
ex.zh: 我們正在投資新興科技。

emerge.en: new and starting to grow or develop

ex.en: It later emerged that the report was wrong.
ex.zh: 後來才發現那份報告是錯的。

ex.en: The truth emerged after the investigation.
ex.zh: 調查後真相浮現了。

ex.en: The company employs 500 workers.
ex.zh: 這家公司僱用了 500 名員工。

ex.en: She employed him as a programmer.
ex.zh: 她僱用他當程式設計師。

ex.en: Six people applied for the job, but none of them were employed.
ex.zh: 有六個人應徵這份工作，但沒有一個被錄取。

employ.en: to pay someone to work for you

ex.en: The grammatical form employed here is the present progressive.
ex.zh: 這裡使用的文法形式是現在進行式。

ex.en: We employ the latest technology in our factory.
ex.zh: 我們的工廠採用最新的技術。

employ.en: to use a method or skill

ex.en: This box is empty. It has nothing in it.
ex.zh: 這個箱子是空的，裡面什麼都沒有。

ex.en: The room was empty except for a shabby bed.
ex.zh: 房間裡除了一張破舊的床，什麼都沒有。

ex.en: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
ex.zh: 你尤其不該空腹喝酒。

ex.en: The neighbours see that the mailbox hasn't been emptied.
ex.zh: 鄰居注意到信箱一直沒有清。

ex.en: Please empty the trash before you leave.
ex.zh: 離開前請把垃圾倒掉。

empty.en: to take everything out of something

ex.en: His promises turned out to be empty.
ex.zh: 他的承諾最後都是空話。

ex.en: I'm tired of empty words.
ex.zh: 我受夠了空洞的話。

ex.en: She found employment as a typist.
ex.zh: 她找到一份打字員的工作。

ex.en: They guaranteed regular employment to their workers.
ex.zh: 他們保證員工能穩定就業。

ex.en: The new factory will create employment for 500 people.
ex.zh: 新工廠將創造五百個就業機會。

employment.en: paid work, or the act of giving someone a job

ex.en: You should learn to control your emotions.
ex.zh: 你應該學著控制自己的情緒。

ex.en: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
ex.zh: 愛比較的心態會讓人產生負面情緒。

ex.en: He hid his emotions and pretended to be enthusiastic.
ex.zh: 他隱藏自己的情緒，假裝很熱心。

emotion.en: a strong feeling such as love, anger or fear

ex.en: People's emotional lives are becoming more and more unstable.
ex.zh: 人們的感情生活越來越不穩定。

ex.en: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
ex.zh: 我在感情上認同，但在現實層面上不同意。

ex.en: She gave me a lot of emotional support.
ex.zh: 她給了我很多情感上的支持。

emotional.zh: 情緒激動的、易動感情的

ex.en: I didn't mean to get emotional.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要那麼激動的。

ex.en: It is not good for a scientist to get emotional.
ex.zh: 科學家太容易情緒化並不好。

ex.en: He got very emotional during his farewell speech.
ex.zh: 他在告別演說時情緒非常激動。

emotional.en: showing strong feelings, often by crying

ex.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
ex.zh: 我想特別強調這一點。

ex.en: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
ex.zh: 線條藝術強調的是形狀和輪廓，而不是色彩、陰影和質感。

ex.en: My manager emphasized the importance of meeting deadlines.
ex.zh: 我的主管強調了準時交件的重要性。

emphasize.en: to show that something is especially important

ex.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
ex.zh: 他強調教育的重要性。

ex.en: I would like to place particular emphasis on this point.
ex.zh: 我想特別強調這一點。

ex.en: This point deserves special emphasis.
ex.zh: 這一點值得特別強調。

ex.en: I didn't mean to embarrass you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意讓你難堪的。

ex.en: You'll embarrass her.
ex.zh: 你會讓她很尷尬。

ex.en: Tom was embarrassed to have to ask for help.
ex.zh: 湯姆不好意思開口求助。

embarrass.en: to make someone feel shy, uncomfortable or ashamed

ex.en: Tom embraced his son.
ex.zh: 湯姆擁抱他的兒子。

ex.en: Tom embraced his father.
ex.zh: 湯姆擁抱了他的父親。

ex.en: He spread his arms as though wanting to embrace the world.
ex.zh: 他張開雙臂，彷彿要擁抱全世界。

embrace.en: to put your arms around someone to show love

ex.en: Our company embraces new technology.
ex.zh: 我們公司樂於接納新科技。

ex.en: She embraced the chance to work abroad.
ex.zh: 她欣然把握到國外工作的機會。

embrace.en: to accept something new with interest and enthusiasm

ex.en: They greeted each other with a warm embrace.
ex.zh: 他們熱情地擁抱彼此打招呼。

ex.en: He held his daughter in a long embrace.
ex.zh: 他緊緊抱著女兒好久。

embrace.en: the act of holding someone in your arms

ex.en: They built their empire in Peru about five hundred years ago.
ex.zh: 他們大約五百年前在秘魯建立了帝國。

ex.en: They increased the territory of the empire.
ex.zh: 他們擴張了帝國的領土。

empire.en: a group of countries ruled by one person or government

ex.en: He built a business empire from a small shop.
ex.zh: 他從一家小店起家，打造出商業帝國。

ex.en: The family owns a media empire.
ex.zh: 這個家族擁有一個媒體王國。

empire.en: a large group of businesses controlled by one person

emit.zh: 排放、發出（光、熱、氣體、聲音）

ex.en: Cars emit large amounts of carbon dioxide.
ex.zh: 汽車排放大量二氧化碳。

ex.en: The device emits a beep when the battery is low.
ex.zh: 電池電量低時，這個裝置會發出嗶聲。

ex.en: The factory was fined for emitting toxic gases.
ex.zh: 這家工廠因排放有毒氣體而被罰款。

emit.en: to send out light, heat, gas or sound

ex.en: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.
ex.zh: 公主向皇帝請求原諒。

ex.en: The Emperor's Birthday fell on Sunday.
ex.zh: 天皇的生日剛好是星期天。

ex.en: The emperor lived in a huge palace.
ex.zh: 皇帝住在一座巨大的宮殿裡。

emperor.en: a man who rules an empire

ex.en: The accountant embezzled money from the company.
ex.zh: 那名會計挪用了公司的錢。

ex.en: He was fired for embezzling client funds.
ex.zh: 他因盜用客戶資金而被開除。

embezzle.en: to secretly take money that belongs to your employer

embark.zh: embark on：開始、著手（新事業、計畫）

ex.en: The old couple embarked on a tour around the world.
ex.zh: 那對老夫婦展開了環遊世界之旅。

ex.en: The company is embarking on a major expansion.
ex.zh: 公司正著手進行大規模擴張。

embark.en: to start something new and important

ex.en: Passengers may embark at 9 a.m.
ex.zh: 乘客可於上午九點登船。

ex.en: We embarked at the port of Keelung.
ex.zh: 我們在基隆港上船。

embark.en: to get on a ship or plane

ex.en: He is an eminent scientist known around the world.
ex.zh: 他是一位聞名全球的卓越科學家。

ex.en: The university invited an eminent historian to give a talk.
ex.zh: 大學邀請了一位著名的歷史學家來演講。

eminent.en: famous and respected, especially for work in a certain field

ex.en: He was rushed to the emergency room after the car accident.
ex.zh: 車禍後他被緊急送到急診室。

ex.en: The emergency room was crowded with patients on Saturday night.
ex.zh: 星期六晚上急診室擠滿了病人。

emergency room.en: the part of a hospital that treats people who need help right away

ex.en: At eight weeks, the embryo is about the size of a bean.
ex.zh: 八週大時，胚胎大約只有一顆豆子那麼大。

ex.en: Doctors checked the embryos before the IVF treatment.
ex.zh: 醫生在試管嬰兒療程前檢查了胚胎。

embryo.en: a baby or animal in the earliest stage of growth before birth

ex.en: Two thirds of the employees of this company are engineers.
ex.zh: 這家公司三分之二的員工是工程師。

ex.en: Japanese companies generally provide their employees with uniforms.
ex.zh: 日本的公司通常都會為員工提供製服。

ex.en: She's not among the regular employees of this company.
ex.zh: 她不是這家公司的正式員工。

employee.en: a person who is paid to work for a company or person

ex.en: Germany is to ban employers from snooping on Facebook.
ex.zh: 德國將禁止雇主在臉書上窺探員工。

ex.en: My employer pays for my health insurance.
ex.zh: 我的雇主幫我付健康保險。

employer.en: a person or company that pays people to work for them

ex.en: The company is expanding into emerging markets.
ex.zh: 公司正拓展新興市場。

ex.en: Emerging technologies may change the industry.
ex.zh: 新興科技可能改變這個產業。

emerging.en: new and becoming stronger or more important

ex.en: The embargo prevented the company from exporting oil.
ex.zh: 這項禁運措施使公司無法出口石油。

ex.en: Several countries called for an end to the trade embargo.
ex.zh: 幾個國家呼籲解除貿易禁運。

embargo.en: an official order that stops trade with another country

ex.en: The accountant was arrested for embezzlement.
ex.zh: 這名會計因侵占公款遭到逮捕。

ex.en: The audit uncovered years of embezzlement.
ex.zh: 這次稽核揭發了多年來的挪用公款情形。

embezzlement.en: the crime of secretly taking money that you are trusted to look after

ex.en: You can play PS2 games on a PC using an emulator.
ex.zh: 你可以用模擬器在電腦上玩 PS2 遊戲。

ex.en: The developer tested the app in an emulator.
ex.zh: 開發人員在模擬器中測試了這款 App。

emulator.en: a program that lets one computer work like a different system

ex.en: The sensor is embedded in the control panel.
ex.zh: 感測器嵌在控制面板裡。

ex.en: The team develops embedded software for appliances.
ex.zh: 團隊為家電開發嵌入式軟體。

ex.en: In case of emergency, call the police.
ex.zh: 遇到緊急情況請報警。

ex.en: In an emergency, use the stairway, not the elevator.
ex.zh: 緊急時請走樓梯，不要搭電梯。

ex.en: You can contact me in case of emergency.
ex.zh: 緊急情況下，您可以聯絡我。

emergency.en: a sudden dangerous situation that needs quick action

ex.en: Where is the Japanese Embassy?
ex.zh: 日本大使館在哪裡？

ex.en: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
ex.zh: 他是美國大使館的外交官。

ex.en: The embassy is located next to the Supreme Court.
ex.zh: 大使館就在最高法院旁邊。

embassy.en: the offices of an official representing a country in a foreign country

ex.en: The teacher emphasised the importance of reading every question carefully.
ex.zh: 老師強調仔細閱讀每一道題目的重要性。

ex.en: She emphasised that the meeting would start exactly at nine.
ex.zh: 她強調會議會準時在九點開始。

ex.en: Please emphasise the key points when you give your presentation.
ex.zh: 你做簡報時請強調重點。

ex.en: He blushed with embarrassment when everyone laughed.
ex.zh: 大家都笑的時候，他尷尬得臉紅了。

ex.en: To my embarrassment, I forgot her name.
ex.zh: 令我尷尬的是，我忘了她的名字。

ex.en: The team's poor performance was an embarrassment to the school.
ex.zh: 那支球隊的糟糕表現讓學校很丟臉。

ex.en: Her singing was an embarrassment at the party.
ex.zh: 她在派對上的歌聲真讓人尷尬。

ex.en: I felt embarrassed when I tripped in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 我在大家面前絆倒，覺得很尷尬。

ex.en: She was embarrassed to ask for help.
ex.zh: 她不好意思開口求助。

ex.en: He gave an embarrassed smile.
ex.zh: 他露出尷尬的微笑。

ex.en: She was emotionally tired after the long trip.
ex.zh: 長途旅行後，她在情緒上很疲憊。

ex.en: He is emotionally close to his sister.
ex.zh: 他和姊姊在情感上很親近。

ex.en: She spoke emotionally about her grandmother.
ex.zh: 她動情地談起她的祖母。

ex.en: The crowd responded emotionally to the song.
ex.zh: 群眾對這首歌的反應很激動。

ex.en: Emily practices the piano for an hour every day.
ex.zh: 艾蜜莉每天練一個小時的鋼琴。

ex.en: I borrowed a pen from Emily during the test.
ex.zh: 考試時我向艾蜜莉借了一支筆。

ex.en: Emma is a popular name for girls in many countries.
ex.zh: 艾瑪在許多國家都是受歡迎的女孩名字。

ex.en: Emma is the title of a novel by Jane Austen.
ex.zh: 《愛瑪》是珍·奧斯汀寫的一本小說。

ex.en: It was so embarrassing when I forgot my own phone number.
ex.zh: 我忘了自己的電話號碼，真是尷尬死了。

ex.en: Her father told an embarrassing story about her childhood.
ex.zh: 她爸爸講了一個關於她童年的糗事。

ex.en: Falling down in front of the whole class was embarrassing.
ex.zh: 在全班面前跌倒真的很丟臉。

ex.en: A good nurse shows empathy for patients.
ex.zh: 好的護理師對病人懷有同理心。

ex.en: Reading stories can help children develop empathy.
ex.zh: 閱讀故事能幫助孩子培養同理心。

ex.en: A sweet smell emanated from the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房裡散發出一股香甜的味道。

ex.en: Soft music emanated from the room upstairs.
ex.zh: 樓上的房間傳出輕柔的音樂。

ex.en: Young players try to emulate their sports heroes.
ex.zh: 年輕球員努力效法他們的運動偶像。

ex.en: She hoped to emulate her mother's kindness.
ex.zh: 她希望能學習母親的善良。

ex.en: Many companies emulate the success of their rivals.
ex.zh: 許多公司仿效對手的成功模式。

ex.en: The emancipation of the slaves changed the country forever.
ex.zh: 奴隸的解放永遠改變了這個國家。

ex.en: Education played a key role in women's emancipation.
ex.zh: 教育在女性解放中扮演了關鍵角色。

ex.en: He felt a deep emptiness after his best friend moved away.
ex.zh: 最要好的朋友搬走後，他感到深深的空虛。

ex.en: The emptiness of the old house made her feel uneasy.
ex.zh: 老房子的空蕩讓她感到不安。

ex.en: She dreamed of winning an Emmy one day.
ex.zh: 她夢想有一天能贏得艾美獎。

ex.en: The actor thanked his family after receiving an Emmy.
ex.zh: 那位演員在獲得艾美獎後感謝了他的家人。

ex.en: Her parents decided to emigrate to Canada.
ex.zh: 她的父母決定移民加拿大。

ex.en: Many young people emigrate to find better jobs.
ex.zh: 許多年輕人為了找更好的工作而移居國外。

ex.en: The maple leaf is the emblem of Canada.
ex.zh: 楓葉是加拿大的象徵。

ex.en: Each player wears the team emblem on his jacket.
ex.zh: 每位球員的外套上都繡著球隊的徽章。

ex.en: The train runs along a high embankment above the fields.
ex.zh: 火車沿著田野上方的高路堤行駛。

ex.en: Workers strengthened the river embankment before the typhoon.
ex.zh: 颱風來臨前，工人加固了河堤。

ex.en: The company is still in an embryonic stage.
ex.zh: 這家公司仍處於萌芽階段。

ex.en: The idea was embryonic, but it soon grew into a real plan.
ex.zh: 這個想法還在雛形階段，但很快就發展成實際的計畫。

ex.en: Scientists studied the embryonic development of the fish.
ex.zh: 科學家研究了這種魚的胚胎發育。

ex.en: Embryonic cells can grow into many different types of tissue.
ex.zh: 胚胎細胞可以發育成許多不同類型的組織。

ex.en: He is a professor emeritus at the university.
ex.zh: 他是這所大學的榮譽退休教授。

ex.en: The emeritus director still visits the lab once a week.
ex.zh: 這位榮譽退休的主任仍每週到實驗室一次。

ex.en: She emphatically denied taking the money.
ex.zh: 她斷然否認拿了那筆錢。

ex.en: "No!" he said emphatically.
ex.zh: 「不！」他堅決地說。

ex.en: She is the embodiment of kindness.
ex.zh: 她是善良的化身。

ex.en: The new bridge is the embodiment of the city's plans for the future.
ex.zh: 這座新橋是這座城市未來規劃的具體展現。

ex.en: She gave an emphatic no to the offer.
ex.zh: 她對這項提議斬釘截鐵地說不。

ex.en: The coach was emphatic about the need to practice.
ex.zh: 教練強調練習的必要性，態度十分堅決。

ex.en: She learned embroidery from her grandmother.
ex.zh: 她跟祖母學刺繡。

ex.en: The dress was decorated with delicate embroidery.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝飾有精緻的刺繡。

ex.en: Abortion is an emotive subject for many people.
ex.zh: 墮胎對許多人來說是個容易激動情緒的話題。

ex.en: The film uses emotive music to make viewers cry.
ex.zh: 這部電影用煽情的音樂讓觀眾落淚。

ex.en: Emigration from the village increased after the factory closed.
ex.zh: 工廠關閉後，這個村莊的人口外移增加了。

ex.en: Her family's emigration to Canada changed their lives.
ex.zh: 她家移居加拿大改變了他們的生活。

ex.en: She wore a ring with a large emerald.
ex.zh: 她戴著一枚鑲著大顆祖母綠的戒指。

ex.en: The emerald is the birthstone for May.
ex.zh: 祖母綠是五月的誕生石。

ex.en: The lake had emerald green water.
ex.zh: 那座湖有翠綠色的湖水。

ex.en: She wore an emerald dress to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿著翠綠色的洋裝去參加派對。

ex.en: She embellished the dress with tiny pearls.
ex.zh: 她用小珍珠裝飾這件洋裝。

ex.en: He tends to embellish his stories to make them more exciting.
ex.zh: 他喜歡把故事加油添醋，讓它更精彩。

empirically.zh: 根據經驗地、以實證方式地

ex.en: The theory was tested empirically in several experiments.
ex.zh: 這個理論在幾次實驗中以實證方式受到檢驗。

ex.en: Empirically, students who sleep well tend to score higher.
ex.zh: 從經驗數據來看，睡得好的學生成績往往較高。

ex.en: The empress ruled the country for many years.
ex.zh: 女皇統治這個國家多年。

ex.en: The empress wore a golden crown at the ceremony.
ex.zh: 皇后在典禮上戴著金色的皇冠。

ex.en: Her kindness is worthy of emulation.
ex.zh: 她的善良值得我們效法。

ex.en: Children learn through emulation of the adults around them.
ex.zh: 孩子透過模仿周遭的大人來學習。

ex.en: There was friendly emulation among the students to get the best grade.
ex.zh: 學生之間為了拿到最好的成績而友善地較勁。

ex.en: The two shops pushed each other to improve out of emulation.
ex.zh: 這兩家店出於互相較勁而彼此精進。

ex.en: The emu is a large bird from Australia that cannot fly.
ex.zh: 鴯鶓是澳洲的一種大型鳥，不會飛。

ex.en: We saw an emu running across the field at the zoo.
ex.zh: 我們在動物園看到一隻鴯鶓跑過草地。

ex.en: My grandmother likes to embroider flowers on pillowcases.
ex.zh: 我奶奶喜歡在枕頭套上繡花。

ex.en: She will embroider your name on the bag for free.
ex.zh: 她會免費在袋子上幫你繡上名字。

ex.en: The city is a hub for emergent technologies.
ex.zh: 這座城市是新興科技的重鎮。

ex.en: An emergent pattern appeared in the data.
ex.zh: 數據中浮現出一種新的模式。

ex.en: She wore a dress with an embroidered collar.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件有刺繡衣領的洋裝。

ex.en: The embroidered pillowcases were a gift from my aunt.
ex.zh: 那些繡花的枕頭套是我阿姨送的禮物。

ex.en: The plan is eminently sensible and easy to follow.
ex.zh: 這個計畫非常合理，也容易執行。

ex.en: She is eminently qualified for the job.
ex.zh: 她完全有資格勝任這份工作。

ex.en: The factory is employing two hundred new workers.
ex.zh: 這間工廠正在僱用兩百名新員工。

ex.en: She solved the problem by employing a simple method.
ex.zh: 她用一個簡單的方法解決了問題。

ex.en: Don't embroil me in your argument.
ex.zh: 不要把我捲進你們的爭吵。

ex.en: The country was embroiled in a long dispute.
ex.zh: 這個國家陷入了一場漫長的爭端。

employed.zh: 僱用（employ 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: The factory employed over two hundred people last year.
ex.zh: 那間工廠去年僱用了兩百多人。

ex.en: She was employed as a nurse at the local hospital.
ex.zh: 她受僱於當地醫院擔任護理師。

ex.en: He has been employed at the same bank for ten years.
ex.zh: 他在同一家銀行工作十年了。

ex.en: Most of my friends are employed full time.
ex.zh: 我大部分的朋友都有全職工作。

emblazon.zh: 以醒目的圖案或文字裝飾

ex.en: The team emblazoned its logo across the front of the jerseys.
ex.zh: 球隊把標誌醒目地印在球衣前面。

ex.en: Her name was emblazoned in gold letters on the door.
ex.zh: 她的名字以金色字母醒目地印在門上。

ex.en: The dove is emblematic of peace.
ex.zh: 鴿子是和平的象徵。

ex.en: The old bridge is emblematic of the city's history.
ex.zh: 那座老橋是這座城市歷史的象徵。

ex.en: A few glowing embers were left in the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁爐裡還剩幾點發亮的餘燼。

ex.en: He blew on the ember until it turned back into a flame.
ex.zh: 他對著餘燼吹氣，直到它重新燃起火焰。

ex.en: The emigrant left his village to find work abroad.
ex.zh: 那位移民離開村子去國外找工作。

ex.en: Many emigrants from Europe crossed the sea in the nineteenth century.
ex.zh: 十九世紀有許多歐洲移民渡海而去。

ex.en: The emigrant family sent letters home every month.
ex.zh: 那個移居外地的家庭每個月都寄信回家。

ex.en: She wrote about her emigrant grandparents in the essay.
ex.zh: 她在文章裡寫到自己移居國外的祖父母。

ex.en: Learning a new skill can be very empowering.
ex.zh: 學會一項新技能可以讓人很有力量。

ex.en: It was an empowering speech that inspired the young women.
ex.zh: 那是一場賦予力量的演講，激勵了年輕女性。

ex.en: The new program is empowering local farmers to sell their goods.
ex.zh: 新計畫讓當地農民有能力自行銷售商品。

ex.en: Education is empowering children to shape their own future.
ex.zh: 教育讓孩子們有能力塑造自己的未來。

embattled.zh: 四面受敵的；陷入困境的

ex.en: The embattled mayor refused to resign.
ex.zh: 四面楚歌的市長拒絕辭職。

ex.en: The embattled company is trying to win back its customers.
ex.zh: 這家深陷困境的公司正努力挽回顧客。

ex.en: Oil and vinegar form an emulsion when you shake them together.
ex.zh: 油和醋一起搖晃就會形成乳狀液。

ex.en: The lotion is a thick emulsion of oil and water.
ex.zh: 這款乳液是油與水混合成的濃稠乳劑。

ex.en: The king sent an emissary to talk peace with the neighboring country.
ex.zh: 國王派了一名使者去和鄰國商談和平。

ex.en: She traveled as an emissary of her government.
ex.zh: 她以政府特使的身分出訪。

ex.en: The early success emboldened him to start his own business.
ex.zh: 早期的成功讓他有膽量自己創業。

ex.en: Her teacher's praise emboldened her to speak up in class.
ex.zh: 老師的稱讚給了她在課堂上發言的勇氣。

ex.en: It is hard to empathize with someone whose life is so different from yours.
ex.zh: 要對生活與你截然不同的人感同身受並不容易。

ex.en: Good nurses empathize with their patients' fears.
ex.zh: 好的護理師能體會病人的恐懼。

emerson.zh: 愛默生（美國思想家、作家）

ex.en: Ralph Waldo Emerson was an American essayist and poet.
ex.zh: 拉爾夫·沃爾多·愛默生是美國的散文家和詩人。

ex.en: We discussed an essay by Emerson in literature class.
ex.zh: 我們在文學課上討論了一篇愛默生的散文。

ex.en: A good nurse is calm and empathetic.
ex.zh: 好的護理師冷靜又有同理心。

ex.en: She gave an empathetic reply to his message.
ex.zh: 她對他的訊息做出了充滿同理心的回應。

ex.en: Empathetic listeners make people feel understood.
ex.zh: 有同理心的傾聽者會讓人覺得被理解。

ex.en: She is emptying the dishwasher right now.
ex.zh: 她現在正在把洗碗機裡的碗盤拿出來。

ex.en: The crowd was emptying out of the stadium after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽結束後，人群正陸續離開體育場。

ex.en: Ancient Egyptians would embalm the bodies of their kings.
ex.zh: 古埃及人會對國王的遺體做防腐處理。

ex.en: The body was embalmed before the funeral.
ex.zh: 遺體在葬禮前已做了防腐處理。

ex.en: Long-term smoking can lead to emphysema and breathing problems.
ex.zh: 長期吸菸可能導致肺氣腫和呼吸困難。

ex.en: My grandfather has emphysema, so he carries an oxygen tank.
ex.zh: 我爺爺有肺氣腫，所以隨身帶著氧氣瓶。

ex.en: The doctor said the X-ray showed signs of emphysema.
ex.zh: 醫生說X光顯示有肺氣腫的跡象。

ex.en: The emigre returned home after thirty years abroad.
ex.zh: 那位流亡者在國外三十年後回到家鄉。

ex.en: Many emigres settled in the city after the war.
ex.zh: 戰後許多流亡者在這座城市定居。

ex.en: The dress has very little embellishment.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝幾乎沒有裝飾。

ex.en: His story was full of embellishment.
ex.zh: 他的故事裡充滿了加油添醋。

ex.en: She rose to eminence as a scientist in her field.
ex.zh: 她在自己的領域中成為享有盛名的科學家。

ex.en: The professor's eminence made him popular as a guest speaker.
ex.zh: 這位教授的崇高名望讓他很受邀請當客座講者。

ex.en: The test was embarrassingly easy for her age group.
ex.zh: 對她這個年齡層來說，這份測驗簡單得令人尷尬。

ex.en: He embarrassingly forgot his own phone number.
ex.zh: 他尷尬地忘了自己的電話號碼。

empathic.zh: 有同理心的；感同身受的

ex.en: A good nurse is calm and empathic with patients.
ex.zh: 好護士對病人沉穩又有同理心。

ex.en: She gave an empathic reply to her friend's worries.
ex.zh: 她對朋友的煩惱給了充滿同理心的回應。

emir.zh: 埃米爾（穆斯林國家的統治者或首領）

ex.en: The emir welcomed the guests to his palace.
ex.zh: 埃米爾在宮殿裡歡迎賓客。

ex.en: In some countries, the ruler is still called an emir.
ex.zh: 在一些國家，統治者仍被稱為埃米爾。

embittered.zh: 使怨恨、使憤恨（過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: Years of unfair treatment embittered him toward his old employer.
ex.zh: 多年的不公平對待讓他對前雇主心懷怨恨。

ex.en: The long legal fight had embittered both families.
ex.zh: 漫長的官司讓兩個家庭都變得怨恨對方。
